test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 19 Jul 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: A dealer purchased a washing machine for Rs. 9,000. He allows a discount of 10% on its marked price and still gains 10%. Find the marked price of the machine.
solution:
**Given : **

CP = Rs.9000

Discount = 10%

Profit = 10%

**Calculation : **

By going through ratio method,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c8d9bd1da98a713488fd9c95a4aa29539773a384c9ca4ef04947e9435ab29edd.png] 

Now by making SP same

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c21acce254a8790f30a247d918e00f5227302affd7af5bb69a5cd4390df28167.png] 

CP = 90 unit = 9000

⇒ 1 unit = 100

MP = 110 unit × 100 = 11000

**∴ The correct answer is 11000.**
